thread:
ashley: quick async check-in: finished the jwt-rotation PR and pushed a small routing policy change for header forwarding. Blocker: staging started showing 429 spikes after the rollout. Anyone else seeing elevated rate limits? cc @lee

omar: seeing 429s on gw-03 around 10:12 UTC tied to /api/v1/chat. Initial guess: header forwarding change caused cache keys to miss and backend got hammered. reproducing locally now, ETA ~30m.

lee: oncall here — I saw the alert at 10:12 and muted for noise, but I collected traces. trace id abc123 shows many short-lived backend calls and retries. could be X-Client-Id mismatch causing cache miss. Uploaded trace bundle.

sam: security check — jwt rotation itself validated fine, but the auth service had a scale-down event around the same time which made token introspection a bit slower. If the gateway retries on slow auth, that could spike traffic to backends and trip rate limits. worth simulating.

ci-bot: CI: canary rollout started for commit 8f9a2 -> staging. Monitor dashboard: https://ci.internal/redwood/commits/8f9a2 :eyes:

omar: rolled back the header-forwarding tweak on staging (removed x-forwarded-client header). rolling through now; watching gw-03 metrics.

ashley: thanks. quick plan:
- lee: re-enable alerts & pull full traces (link in the trace bundle)
- omar: confirm rollback impact in 15m and drop a short note in the PR
- sam: run auth-service scale test + token introspection latency sim
- i'll open a short ticket with steps and attach logs / dashboard snapshots

lee: re-enabled alerts, trace bundle uploaded: https://logs.redwood/trace/abc123. If 429s persist after rollback i'll escalate and start a short mitigation (increase rate-limit headroom on staging).

ashley: small config snippet I tested locally that caused the miss: ```json
{"forward_headers": ["x-client-id", "x-forwarded-client"], "cache_key": "{{path}}:{{header.x-client-id}}"}
```

omar: update: metrics look much better after rollback, 429s dropped to baseline. i'll hold the change behind a feature flag and re-propose with a canary flow. PR note incoming. :thumbsup:
